name: – After § 3 – Am 1
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the cases of unjustly imprisoned Uyghurs in China, notably Ilham Tohti and Gulshan Abbas
part_text: 3a. Praises the work of the Spokesperson for the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights who is again calling for the authorities to undertake a full review of the legal framework governing national security and counterterrorism; notes with great concern that this legal framework is extensively used to detain and convict Uyghurs and other predominantly Muslim communities; notes, besides, a worrying increase in the use of the fight against terrorism as a pretext to repress populations or political opponents around the world;
